verdict.rationale: Teller is a developer banking-data API, and such a SaaS platform could plausibly offer a natural-language or agent-driven interface, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only REST endpoints, mTLS authentication, webhooks, a dashboard and Teller Connect, with no natural-language command capability. Probes for llms.txt, docs.md and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so no AI-native operation surface is evidenced.
